channel_partners_coordinates.name: channel_partners_coordinates
channel_partners_coordinates.value: ("channel_partners"."latitude" IS NULL AND "channel_partners"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("channel_partners"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "channel_partners"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

schemes_income_range.name: schemes_income_range
schemes_income_range.value: "schemes"."min_income" IS NULL OR "schemes"."max_income" IS NULL OR "schemes"."min_income" <= "schemes"."max_income"

schemes_loan_range.name: schemes_loan_range
schemes_loan_range.value: "schemes"."min_loan_amount" IS NULL OR "schemes"."max_loan_amount" IS NULL OR "schemes"."min_loan_amount" <= "schemes"."max_loan_amount"
